queries.unload_primary: UNLOAD (SELECT q.domain, q.url, q.fetch_time, q.fetch_status, q.content_digest, q.content_mime_type, q.url_type, q.stratum FROM (SELECT c.domain AS domain, c.stratum AS stratum, ci.url AS url, ci.fetch_time AS fetch_time, ci.fetch_status AS fetch_status, ci.content_digest AS content_digest, ci.content_mime_type AS content_mime_type, (CASE WHEN strpos(ci.url, '?') > 0 THEN 'query' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/?(#.*)?$') THEN 'root' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/[^/?]+/?(#.*)?$') THEN 'path1' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/') THEN 'pathN' ELSE 'malformed' END) AS url_type, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.domain, (CASE WHEN strpos(ci.url, '?') > 0 THEN 'query' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/?(#.*)?$') THEN 'root' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/[^/?]+/?(#.*)?$') THEN 'path1' WHEN regexp_like(ci.url, '^https?://[^/?]+/') THEN 'pathN' ELSE 'malformed' END) ORDER BY abs(from_big_endian_64(xxhash64(to_utf8(concat(url, '|', '2')))))) AS rn FROM ccindex ci JOIN wave_cands_wave_s0_20260917T101131Z c ON ci.url_host_registered_domain = c.domain WHERE ci.crawl = 'CC-MAIN-2026-34' AND ci.subset = 'warc' AND ci.fetch_status = 200) q WHERE q.rn <= 6) TO 's3://phishnet-athena/wave/cc-fetch-wave_s0_20260917T101131Z/primary/' WITH (format = 'PARQUET', partitioned_by = ARRAY['stratum'])
